gaps: CANADA: no Study Group centres or Canadian partners found. students.studygroup.com partner list shows only UK (14) and Ireland (UCD); studygroup.com/about-us lists Ireland, UK, USA, Singapore, China. Treat as no current Canadian centres (a search found no named Canadian partner).

www.studygroup.com/study-centres returned 404; centre list taken from students.studygroup.com/study-options/international-pathway-programmes (14 UK partners). University College Dublin (Ireland) and Bellerbys excluded as out of scope.

Student-site programme pages state no durations, fees or English requirements; these were read from each centre's own ISC site (fees and entry-requirements pages, 2026/27 fees for programmes starting on/after 26 Aug 2026). Fees are per programme route as stated, in GBP; earlier 2025/26 fees not published.

Leeds and Royal Holloway ISC fee/entry pages were read via leeds-preview.studygroup.com and rhul-preview.studygroup.com (Study Group preview mirrors) plus www.rhulisc.com for Royal Holloway entry requirements; verify against live ISC sites.

Where a programme has a single IELTS line it is Academic IELTS for UKVI as stated. Many programmes have pre-sessional English Language Preparation routes (online 6/10/16 weeks etc.) which were excluded as English-only courses.

Durations not stated on any official page: Aberdeen UFP and International Year Two; Huddersfield all; Leeds Beckett all; Leeds Pre-Masters; Durham IFY/Accelerated IFY/Year One (Cardiff IFY 1 year, Accelerated 22 weeks and Bath IFY 1 year taken from entry-requirements pages); Sussex IFY.
Cardiff, Aberdeen: Aberdeen Pre-Masters duration (12 weeks) from the student page; Strathclyde Accelerated Pre-Masters fee/12 weeks from ISC fees page.

Sussex: English requirement for International Foundation Year not found (entry-requirements sub-page 404); IFY/Extended IY1 intakes: Extended International Year One intake not stated. Sussex Pre-Masters intakes listed per semester option on student page.

LJMU: Extended International Foundation Year (3 terms, September) has no fee on the fees page and no English requirement found; Pre-Masters/IFY IELTS from sub-pages. LJMU IFY intakes include October per student page.
Durham: Accelerated IFY and International Year One intakes not stated; Pre-Masters durations/fees per ISC fees page. Durham city given as Stockton-on-Tees per student page.
Kingston Pre-Masters: fee page lists 1 term only (GBP 8,900); student page also lists two-term intakes (Nov, Jan, Feb) with no fee.

Leeds: student page also lists International Year One Business Management with Marketing; no fee/route on ISC fees page, so omitted. Surrey Pre-Masters: student page lists Engineering and Health & Medical Sciences routes but ISC fees page lists only Management, Finance, Hospitality and Tourism; others omitted.
Sheffield: fees given for 1.5- and 2-semester variants of IFY and Pre-Masters; Year One entries have no duration beyond 2 semesters fee row.

Some centres (Cardiff, Aberdeen, Strathclyde, Huddersfield) offer 'Year Two' or Foundation routes progressing straight to Year 2; classified Foundation/Pathway by name. Bath, Leeds Beckett, Huddersfield, Kingston: city of London/Greater London given only for Kingston.
